headline: Mirpur eviction drive: Hawkers need alternative spaces, says Shafiqur Rahman
summary: Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer and Leader of the Opposition calls for a coordinated solution to Dhaka's hawker problem following violent clashes in Mirpur.
details: A Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) eviction drive in Mirpur turned violent, leading to clashes and the burning of government vehicles.
caption:
Roads should be clear, but where do the small traders go?

A Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) eviction drive in Mirpur turned violent, leading to clashes and the burning of government vehicles.

headline_marked: [[Retired Major General arrested]] over New Gini Properties attack
headline: Retired Major General arrested over New Gini Properties attack
summary: Police have detained Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury in connection with the attack on a housing project in the ECB circle area of Dhaka.
details: Police have arrested Retired Major General Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury in connection with an attack on the New Gini Properties housing project.
The incident took place in the ECB circle area of the capital city, Dhaka.
Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury was listed as the fourth accused in the primary information report (FIR) filed regarding the attack.
The arrest was carried out by the police as part of the ongoing investigation into the incident.
caption:
A retired Major General has been arrested in Dhaka.

Police have arrested Retired Major General Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury in connection with an attack on the New Gini Properties housing project.

The incident took place in the ECB circle area of the capital city, Dhaka.

Golam Mohiuddin Chowdhury was listed as the fourth accused in the primary information report (FIR) filed regarding the attack.

The arrest was carried out by the police as part of the ongoing investigation into the incident.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #CrimeNews #LawEnforcement

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, bdnews24.com
